milestones.title: 1st draft design confirmed
milestones.note: Lock the kitchen and counter layout.

milestones.title: 2nd (final) draft design confirmed
milestones.note: Have the chef candidate check the kitchen and counter layout.

milestones.title: Submit all renovation documents to mall management
milestones.note: Ask mall management for their checklist and approval time now.

milestones.title: Renovation complete & handover
milestones.note: Get the contractor to commit to this date in writing.

milestones.title: Plating / tableware ordered
milestones.note: Plates are needed for the early-November photoshoot.

milestones.title: Cookware & supplies from China confirmed (boxes, rice, etc.)
milestones.note: Sea freight takes 4–6 weeks, so choose air freight if it's late.

milestones.title: Fridges & sushi display case confirmed
milestones.note: Local supplier. Share the models' sizes and power needs with the contractor early.

milestones.title: Business email & phone number set up
milestones.note: Instagram, the website and KOL outreach all need these.

milestones.title: Website & marketing live (1-month pre-launch)
milestones.note: Include a booking or waitlist link.

milestones.title: Instagram pre-launch starts
milestones.note: Teaser content: the chef, ingredients, renovation.

milestones.title: Menu & chef photoshoot
milestones.note: Needs the chef, plates and suppliers ready.

milestones.title: KOL / bloggers confirmed
milestones.note: Book their tasting slots from 1 Dec.

milestones.title: Reservation / deposit system live
milestones.note: Take a deposit to cut no-shows.

milestones.title: CS / Manager hired
milestones.note: Allows for a 1-month notice period and time to set up SOPs and bookings.

milestones.title: Waiters hired
milestones.note: Allow for notice periods plus 1–2 weeks of training.

milestones.title: Food handler course & typhoid jab — all staff
milestones.note: Required for all food handlers in Malaysia.

milestones.title: Staff training & dry-run services
milestones.note: Run 2–3 full dry-run services before opening.

milestones.title: Utilities, internet line, POS & card terminal ready
milestones.note: Book the internet line early. Installation takes 2–3 weeks.
